name: GetActiveCellOnExcelWorksheet
label: Get Active Cell on Excel Worksheet
description: Gets the address of the currently active cell in the specified Excel worksheet.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet instance from which to get the active cell.

fields.name: ActiveCellAddress
fields.label: Active Cell Address
fields.description: Returns the address of the active cell (e.g., 'A1').

fields.name: ActiveCellColumnIndex
fields.label: Active Cell Column Index
fields.description: Returns the column index of the active cell.

fields.name: ActiveCellRowIndex
fields.label: Active Cell Row Index
fields.description: Returns the row index of the active cell.
